name: Martha Stroll
style: Practical everyday wear, comfort for long days on her feet
shopping_habits: Mom of two. On weekends she sits down with her phone while the kids are occupied and browses Skechers.com looking for shoes for her 5-year-old daughter and 9-year-old son. Shops for herself last, if at all. Price-sensitive, loyal to rewards programs, researches before buying.
tech_comfort: Digital-native, shops primarily on mobile, expects personalization and fast checkout
focus_areas: 9-year-old boy: lace-up sneakers, durable soles, blue/black
